name: skills
one_liner: A set of official instruction files, published by Google, that teach AI coding assistants the correct, current way to build Android apps.
buyer: A mobile dev shop or solo Android developer who wants their AI coding assistant to stop writing outdated or subtly wrong Android code.
business_use_cases: An app development agency installs these skills across every Android project so AI-generated code follows current Google best practices, catching mistakes a less experienced reviewer might miss.
A coding bootcamp uses the skills as teaching material so students' AI-assisted exercises reflect real, current Android patterns instead of stale training-data habits.
A solo indie app developer avoids shipping outdated Stack-Overflow-era AI suggestions when adding a new feature to their app.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid audit service that reviews an agency's existing AI-generated Android codebase against these official patterns and fixes what's outdated.

steal_this: Install it in your Android project this weekend and see which specific AI mistakes it actually catches before trusting it unsupervised on client work.
